page.overview:
Who is Posey?

Posey is a female Earth pony and supporting character in My Little Pony Generation 5, first appearing as the antagonist of the hour-long special My Little Pony: Make Your Mark. She is a resident of the seaside Earth pony town of Maretime Bay who initially resents the return of magic and the union between Earth ponies, unicorns, and Pegasi.

She is called Posey Bloom in merchandise.

Posey is based on the G1 Earth pony of the same name, who also inspired the G4 Pegasus pony Fluttershy; she even shares G1 Posey's cutie mark. Her name is also similar to the G1 Earth ponies Posey Rose and Posey Barrington and the G3 Earth pony Rosey Posey, and she shares her last name with the G1 Pegasus pony Brilliant Bloom, the G3 Pegasus pony Twinkle Bloom, and the G4 Earth pony filly Apple Bloom.

In the hour-long special My Little Pony: Make Your Mark, Posey first appears when Izzy Moonbow crashes through her garden. Following the return of magic to Equestria at the end of My Little Pony: A New Generation, Posey considers its return to be a bad thing, claiming Pegasi's flight and unicorns' telekinesis are an inconvenience to Earth ponies' everyday lives; she is especially bitter because Earth ponies do not have magic of their own. When magic starts to glitch in and out around Maretime Bay and Earth ponies find their hooves temporarily getting stuck to the ground, Posey assumes it is the work of a unicorn prank and complains to town sheriff Hitch Trailblazer.
